# nobus_fos_object_content (Data Source)

Downloads a Nobus FOS object. The content is stored in Terraform state as sensitive base64.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nobus_fos_object_content" "manifest" {
  container_name = "terraform-assets"
  object_name    = "manifest.json"
}

output "manifest_sha256" {
  value = data.nobus_fos_object_content.manifest.sha256
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container_name` (String)
- `object_name` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number)
- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sha256` (String)
